newsitem.title: PERU: Earthquake hits central Peruvian Andes.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits central Peruvian Andes.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 3.8 on the Richter scale hit the central Peruvian Andes early on Saturday but local radio said there was no serious damage.

The epicentre of the quake, which struck at 1:09 a.m. local time (0609 GMT), was just outside the town of Huancayo, 190 miles (300 km) northeast of the capital Lima, an official at the Peruvian Geophysics Institute told radio.
"There is no information of damage, just frayed nerves among the people," he said, adding that the situation was still being evaluated.
